name: amazon-toolbox
description: 课赛通 KST · 跨境电商赛训效率平台
author: 课赛通 KST 团队

scripts.verify:marketing: npm run test:marketing-publish && npm run build:marketing && npm run marketing:audit && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set PLAYWRIGHT_MARKETING_PREBUILT=1 -- playwright test --config=playwright.marketing.config.ts
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set TOOLBOX_BUILD_TARGET=electron -- vite build --mode production
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath build\dist --workpath build\work toolbox-backend.spec && copy /Y build\dist\toolbox-backend.exe ..\electron\toolbox-backend.exe
scripts.electron:build: npm run desktop:prepare-nsis && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false -- electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.electron:release: npm run release:validate && npm run desktop:prepare-nsis && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false -- electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test: npm run electron:compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:electron-workflow
scripts.test:coverage: npm run electron:compile && vitest run --coverage --exclude src/tests/electron/automationWorkflow.test.ts && npm run test:electron-workflow
scripts.test:mariadb:required: node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set REQUIRE_MARIADB_TEST=1 -- npm run test:mariadb
scripts.test:e2e:release: npm run build:web && npm run web:audit && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set PLAYWRIGHT_PREBUILT=1 -- playwright test --config=playwright.business.config.ts && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set PLAYWRIGHT_PREBUILT=1 -- playwright test --config=playwright.internal.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run source:check && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.openapi:generate: node scripts/run-python.mjs -- scripts/export_openapi.py --output backend/openapi.json && node scripts/run-python.mjs -- scripts/generate_openapi_types.py
scripts.openapi:check: node scripts/run-python.mjs -- scripts/export_openapi.py --output backend/openapi.json --check && node scripts/run-python.mjs -- scripts/check_openapi_compat.py && node scripts/run-python.mjs -- scripts/generate_openapi_types.py --check
scripts.desktop:verify-package: npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/with-toolbox-data-root.mjs --set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false -- electron-builder --win --dir && npm run package:audit
scripts.desktop:verify-installer: npm run electron:release && npm run package:audit && node scripts/verify-nsis-artifacts.mjs
scripts.docker:test:mariadb: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f compose.yaml --profile test run --rm backend-tests
scripts.verify:backend:static: node scripts/run-python.mjs -- -m ruff check backend && node scripts/run-python.mjs -- -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app backend/core backend/domains backend/services backend/routers
scripts.verify:backend: npm run test:backend && npm run verify:backend:static
scripts.verify: npm run security:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run architecture:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run api-contracts:check && npm run deadcode && npm test && npm run build:desktop && npm run verify:backend
scripts.verify:release: npm run release:policy && npm run security:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run architecture:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run api-contracts:check && npm run deadcode && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run test:backend:diff-coverage && npm run verify:backend:static && npm run release:mariadb-gate && npm run test:e2e:release && npm run test:e2e:real && npm run verify:marketing && npm run desktop:verify-package
